sports.h3: Sabalenka survives Noskova thriller, Tiafoe wins five-setter in New York
sports.summary: On Tuesday 8 September Aryna Sabalenka beat Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova 7-6(1) 3-6 7-6(7) to reach a sixth straight US Open semifinal, while Frances Tiafoe came from two sets down to beat Alex Michelsen.
body: Top seed Aryna Sabalenka kept her bid for a third consecutive US Open title alive on Tuesday 8 September, edging sixth seed Linda Noskova in a match that lasted two hours and 22 minutes at Arthur Ashe Stadium. According to ESPN, Sabalenka closed it out with a second-serve ace in the deciding tiebreak after Noskova, who won Wimbledon in July, had hit 18 aces and saved seven of nine break points.

CBS Sports reported that Sabalenka fell behind 4-2 in the third set before breaking straight back, avoiding the kind of collapse that has cost her in earlier majors. She now faces either Jessica Pegula or Emma Navarro in Thursday's semifinal, with the two Americans meeting in Tuesday's night session.

sports.h3: Van de Zandschulp survives five-hour epic, meets Zverev in quarterfinal
sports.summary: Botic van de Zandschulp came back from two sets down and saved a match point to beat Arthur Gea in five hours and 13 minutes, NOS reported early on Tuesday 8 September. He faces top seed Alexander Zverev on Wednesday.
body: The last Dutch player standing at the US Open reached the quarterfinals for the second time in his career after a 3-6 6-7(0) 7-6(7) 7-6(3) 6-4 win over Frenchman Arthur Gea that finished in the early hours of Tuesday New York time. NL Times noted that the 30-year-old lost the second-set tiebreak 7-0 and then saved a match point in the third before taking the next two tiebreaks.

In the fifth set Van de Zandschulp broke in the opening game, was broken straight back, then broke again in the seventh game and served out the match. His only previous quarterfinal was also in New York, in 2021, when he lost in four sets to eventual champion Daniil Medvedev.

sports.h3: Alcaraz and Shelton headline Tuesday night session at Arthur Ashe
sports.summary: Defending champion Carlos Alcaraz met home favourite Ben Shelton in the late quarterfinal on Tuesday 8 September, after Jessica Pegula and Emma Navarro opened the night session in the first all-American women's quarterfinal since 2015.
body: The ATP Tour reported that eighth seed Ben Shelton reached the last eight without facing a break point against Stefanos Tsitsipas, winning 6-2 6-3 6-4, while Alcaraz beat Tommy Paul 6-4 6-3 6-4 to extend his Grand Slam winning streak to 18 matches. Alcaraz led the head to head 3-0 going into the match, and Shelton told Olympics.com he would need special tennis to beat the Spaniard for the first time.

With Jannik Sinner absent after withdrawing before the tournament and Novak Djokovic out in the first round, Alcaraz is the clear favourite for the title. The winner plays Frances Tiafoe in Friday's semifinal. ESPN noted that three of the four remaining men in the top half were American, giving the hosts their best chance in years of ending a men's singles drought that dates back to 2003.

sports.h3: America's Cup teams cleared to train in Naples ahead of preliminary regatta
sports.summary: From Wednesday 9 September the nine crews entered for the Louis Vuitton 38th America's Cup Preliminary Regatta in Naples are permitted to train on the Bay of Naples, with racing scheduled for 24 to 27 September.
body: The Naples event is the second official regatta of the current cycle and the first competitive racing on the course that will host the Louis Vuitton Cup and the America's Cup Match in 2027, according to Emirates Team New Zealand. Teams will race identical AC40 foiling yachts off the Lungomare between Castel dell'Ovo and Posillipo, with fleet races on 25 and 26 September and a winner-takes-all match race final on 27 September.

Six teams and nine boats will take part. Emirates Team New Zealand, GB1 and Luna Rossa each field a second AC40 for their Women's and Youth crews, while Tudor Team Alinghi, La Roche-Posay Racing Team and the American Racing Challenger Team USA bring one boat each. The Americans join the preliminary fleet for the first time this cycle. Australia is not yet competing.

sports.h3: Antonelli wins Monza from 20th on the grid, extends title lead to 66 points
sports.summary: Kimi Antonelli went from the back of the grid to victory at the Italian Grand Prix on Sunday 6 September, beating Mercedes teammate George Russell by 3.9 seconds with Max Verstappen third for Red Bull.
body: PlanetF1 described the drive as sensational. Antonelli had taken a back-of-the-grid engine penalty and started 20th, yet was up to sixth by the standing restart that followed a red flag for Charles Leclerc's heavy crash at Parabolica on lap two. Leclerc was unhurt. Verstappen led by lap 12 before both Mercedes closed in, and Antonelli passed Russell for the lead at the start of lap 18.

Pierre Gasly had taken his first career pole for Alpine and led the opening laps but faded to seventh. Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri finished fourth and fifth for McLaren, Lewis Hamilton was sixth for Ferrari after being forced onto the gravel by Leclerc early on and rookie Arvid Lindblad took eighth for Racing Bulls. Lance Stroll and Fernando Alonso both retired for Aston Martin.

sports.h3: Verstappen tells Red Bull its weaknesses were clear despite Monza podium
sports.summary: An untelevised radio exchange published on Tuesday 8 September showed Max Verstappen telling team boss Laurent Mekies that the RB22's weaknesses were obvious at Monza, days after Helmut Marko admitted the car's development had gone in the wrong direction.
body: Motorsport Week reported that Mekies praised Verstappen's race pace and overtaking as a big step forward on the cooldown lap. Verstappen replied that the podium was nice but that the team could clearly see its weaknesses, pointing to straight-line speed and ride quality. He later said a rear axle problem first noticed in qualifying had stayed with him all race and that the car struggled over bumps and kerbs.

The Dutchman also said Red Bull cannot match the energy deployment of the Mercedes-powered cars, which hurts on a track like Monza. His third place followed a first-lap crash at his home race in Zandvoort and was his third podium in four races, but Red Bull has still not won a Grand Prix in 2026.

sports.h3: PSV beats Ajax 3-1 in tempestuous Amsterdam topper, AZ stays perfect
sports.summary: PSV won 1-3 at the Johan Cruijff ArenA on Saturday 5 September through goals from Ricardo Pepi, Lutsharel Geertruida and Esmir Bajraktarevic, while AZ remained the only Eredivisie side with a perfect record after five rounds.
body: NOS described an exceptional first half in which both teams attacked relentlessly. Pepi scored after five minutes from a Ruben van Bommel header, Tolu Arokodare levelled for Ajax in the 23rd minute and Geertruida restored PSV's lead just before the break from a corner. Ajax had chances through Steven Berghuis and Davy Klaassen to go ahead in between.

The second half was less open and grew ugly in the final quarter when Van Bommel injured Aaron Bouwman with a reckless challenge, sparking scuffles and yellow cards for six players and Ajax coach Michel. Substitute Bajraktarevic settled the game in stoppage time from a Sven Mijnans pass. Ajax debutants included Sofyan Amrabat and Viktor Tsyhankov.

sports.h3: NEC denies Excelsior historic start with stoppage-time equaliser
sports.summary: Noe Lebreton scored in injury time to give NEC a 2-2 draw against Excelsior in a rearranged Eredivisie match in Nijmegen on Tuesday 8 September, denying the Rotterdam club a move up to third place.
body: The match was the postponed round three fixture, moved because of NEC's European commitments. Voetbal International reported that NEC coach made eight changes and Adam Tahaui rewarded him with a 10th-minute opener, cutting inside from the edge of the box and finishing into the near corner. Irakli Yegoian set up David Garden to equalise just before half-time on a rain-soaked pitch.

Excelsior debutant Valentin Sulzbacher, signed from Red Bull Salzburg, scored with his first touch to put the visitors 2-1 up in the second half. NEC's Perr Schuurs, recently back from a long injury layoff, came close to levelling and Dusan Tadic headed a late chance wide before Lebreton pounced in stoppage time.

sports.h3: Dumfries beats former club Inter as Real Madrid open Champions League
sports.summary: Denzel Dumfries started for Real Madrid in a 2-1 win over Internazionale at the Bernabeu on Tuesday 8 September, his first Champions League match since leaving the Italian club after 207 appearances.
body: Voetbal International reported that Kylian Mbappe opened the scoring after Inter lost possession, with Brahim Diaz providing the pass. The goal took Mbappe to 71 Champions League goals, level with Real icon Raul and behind only Cristiano Ronaldo, Lionel Messi, Robert Lewandowski and Karim Benzema on the all-time list. Federico Valverde made it 2-0 after a poor back pass from Benjamin Pavard.

Inter goalkeeper Josep Martinez kept the Italians in the game with a string of saves from Mbappe and Carlos Augusto pulled one back with about 15 minutes left, but Thibaut Courtois held firm. Jose Mourinho, who won the Champions League with Inter in 2010, handed Dumfries the start against the club where he reached two Champions League finals between 2021 and 2026.

sports.h3: ADCC Worlds head to Krakow this weekend without Ryan, Ruotolos or Reis
sports.summary: The ADCC World Championships take place at Tauron Arena in Krakow on 12 and 13 September, the first time Poland has hosted the event and the first European edition since 2017. Brackets are revealed on Friday 11 September.
body: FloGrappling, which streams the event, notes that the biennial tournament returns to Europe with a new host. MMA Mania reported on Monday 7 September that the field is thinner on star power than in previous years: Gordon Ryan retired early in 2026, vacating the superfight belt after 17 years, Craig Jones is also retired and Kade and Tye Ruotolo, Andrew Tackett and Nick Rodriguez are not on the card.

Five reigning champions have withdrawn, including Adele Fornarino for a UFC BJJ title shot and Diogo Reis and Mica Galvao following the arrest of coach Melqui Galvao. Three champions do return, among them Felipe Pena and double champion Kaynan Duarte, who will compete at 99 kg, face Yuri Simoes in the headline superfight and possibly enter the absolute division as well.

sports.h3: Budapest Grand Slam draws 536 judoka from 70 nations this weekend
sports.summary: The IJF Hungary Grand Slam runs from 11 to 13 September in Budapest, home city of the International Judo Federation, with 326 men and 210 women entered across the 14 weight categories.
body: The IJF lists 536 competitors from 70 countries and six continents for the Budapest event, which the federation billed as the September centrepiece of the World Judo Tour. European federations account for 397 of the entries, with 54 from Asia, 45 from the Pan-American confederation and 27 from Africa.

Day one on Friday covers the men's -60 kg and -66 kg and the women's -48 kg, -52 kg and -57 kg. Saturday brings the men's -73 kg and -81 kg alongside the women's -63 kg and -70 kg, with the heavier categories on Sunday. The -73 kg division is the largest with 65 entries.

sports.h3: IBJJF World Master wraps three days in Las Vegas as Jiu-Jitsu Con follows
sports.summary: The IBJJF World Master Championship ran from 3 to 5 September in Las Vegas with brown and black belts across seven Master age divisions, FloGrappling reported, with the IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Con seminar programme staged alongside.
body: FloGrappling's coverage described an action-packed opening day with some academies dominating both male and female divisions. All seven Master age groups, from Master 1 for competitors aged 30 and over up to Master 7, held matches on day one, followed by purple belt divisions and the older black belt brackets on Friday.

Full results by weight, belt and age group are published on the IBJJF results database. The event is one of the largest gi tournaments on the calendar and doubles as a gathering point for the sport, with the Jiu-Jitsu Con seminar schedule running in the same venue.

consumer-tech.h3: Apple event today: iPhone 18 Pro and first foldable iPhone expected
consumer-tech.summary: Apple holds its September event on Wednesday 9 September at 10:00 Pacific time, 19:00 in Amsterdam, where MacRumors expects the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, a book-style foldable possibly called iPhone Ultra, two Apple Watches and AirPods 5.
body: MacRumors' event preview says the foldable will have a roughly 5.5-inch outer OLED display and a 7.8-inch inner screen in a layout wider than it is tall, closer to a folded iPad mini than a conventional phone. It is expected to be around 4.5 mm thick when open, use a Touch ID side button instead of Face ID and carry a dual rear camera without a telephoto lens. Bloomberg has reported that MagSafe charging will be included.

The device is expected to run a 2 nm A20 Pro chip with 12 GB of RAM and possibly Apple's own C2 modem. The standard iPhone 18 is not expected at this event, with Apple reportedly shifting it to a spring 2027 launch. Other products tipped for the keynote include the Apple Watch Series 12 with a ceramic case option, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and AirPods 5 in versions with and without active noise cancellation.

consumer-tech.h3: Huawei unveils Mate XT2 tri-fold with built-in privacy display
consumer-tech.summary: Huawei launched the Mate XT2 Ultimate Design in China on Monday 7 September, a tri-panel foldable that opens to a 10.2-inch 3K screen, priced from 19,999 yuan or about 2,980 dollars, Engadget reported.
body: Engadget said the Mate XT2 is the first tri-fold with a built-in privacy display, a feature Samsung introduced on the Galaxy S26 Ultra. The new hinge folds the panels inwards, unlike the 2024 original, and the phone measures 6.5 inches when closed. It runs Huawei's Kirin 9050 Pro chip, which the company claims is 42 percent faster than the chip in the first Mate XT.

The camera system comprises a 50-megapixel main sensor, a 40-megapixel ultra-wide and a 50-megapixel periscope with 3.5x optical zoom, plus an 8-megapixel selfie camera on the inner display. The phone ships with HarmonyOS 7.

consumer-tech.h3: Xiaomi 18 Fold debuts in-house XRING O3 chip and A4-ratio screens
consumer-tech.summary: Xiaomi formally launched the 18 Fold, its first so-called mid-size foldable, with a 7.68-inch inner and 5.38-inch outer display, Engadget reported on Tuesday 8 September after hands-on time at IFA in Berlin.
body: The phone is the first Xiaomi flagship to run the company's own XRING O3 processor, built on a 3 nm process with a 10-core all-big-core CPU and 16-core GPU. Xiaomi says it is the first system on chip to support LPDDR6 memory and claims 45 percent faster on-device NPU decoding than its previous flagship chip.

Both screens use a new Xiaomi HyperRGB panel with a full RGB subpixel structure, peak brightness of 4,000 nits and 1-120 Hz adaptive refresh. At 219 grams it is the lightest foldable Xiaomi has made, although Engadget found it slightly thicker than Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 with a larger battery. A three-link hinge and Shield Glass 3.0 protect the displays.

consumer-tech.h3: IFA 2026 wrap: stair-climbing robot vacuums and a fanless 10 mm laptop
consumer-tech.summary: As IFA Berlin closed on Tuesday 8 September, TechRadar and Gizmochina named Roborock's wheel-legged Saros Rover and Lenovo's solid-state-cooled Project AeroBlade among the standout reveals of the show.
body: Gizmochina reported that the Saros Rover drew the longest queues at the show. Roborock describes it as the first robot vacuum built on a wheel-leg architecture that raises or lowers each leg independently, performs small jumps and adjusts its body on slopes, letting it cross thresholds and individual stair steps.

Lenovo's Project AeroBlade concept is a 14-inch ThinkBook under 830 grams and under 10 mm thick that replaces fans with Frore's AirJet solid-state cooling chips. TechRadar's Best in Show list of 25 products also included Acer's 799 gram Swift Blade 14, Anker's MindBase smart home hub, Mammotion mowing robots, exoskeletons and modular solar batteries aimed at renters.

consumer-tech.h3: Sony revives the WH-1000XM4 as a 300 dollar XM4C
consumer-tech.summary: Sony is bringing back its 2020 headphones as the WH-1000XM4C this autumn at 299.99 dollars, alongside the 180 dollar WH-CH730N and 69.99 dollar WH-CH530 arriving in September, Engadget reported on Monday 7 September.
body: Rather than build a new upper-midrange model, Sony is reissuing a well-reviewed favourite with the same design as the original XM4. The XM4C keeps QN1-powered active noise cancellation and multipoint Bluetooth and adds Sony's latest sound tuning, a 10-band equaliser, a gaming EQ and the Quick Access shortcut for streaming services.

Battery life drops to 27 hours with noise cancelling on, three hours less than the original, but a three-minute charge now gives an hour of playback. At 300 dollars it undercuts the current WH-1000XM6 by a wide margin and comes in black and platinum silver.

consumer-tech.h3: Nintendo announces Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 for 29 October
consumer-tech.summary: Nintendo used a Zelda anniversary Direct on Tuesday 8 September to announce a Triforce-themed Switch 2 console, Pro Controller and carrying case launching on 29 October, with a general Nintendo Direct following on Wednesday.
body: Nintendo's press release lists the Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition at 62,980 yen in Japan. The console, dock and Joy-Con 2 controllers carry Triforce motifs, and the matching Pro Controller and case release the same day.

Nintendo Life reported that the Direct focused on non-game initiatives for the anniversary as well as details of the Switch 2 version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. EventHubs noted that a general Nintendo Direct is scheduled for 9 September, so broader software news was held back a day.

consumer-tech.h3: September Android drop adds Gemini inventory, Motion Assist and video search
consumer-tech.summary: Google's September Android update brings five features across Gemini, Find Hub and Messages to hundreds of millions of phones, Android Authority reported, while Pixel 6 owners receive Android 17 QPR1 as their final major OS upgrade.
body: The drop lets users build a searchable inventory of belongings in Find Hub by telling Gemini where items are stored, adds a Motion Assist overlay designed to reduce motion sickness when reading on the move and extends Circle to Search to content inside videos in supported apps. Google Keep notes and lists can now be shared and edited by everyone in a Google Messages chat, and Gemini Live gains a guided vision mode that describes what the camera sees.

Forbes reported that some features reach devices as old as Android 9, with Samsung Galaxy phones included alongside Pixels. Separately, Google's Pixel package bundles the monthly security patch, the final Android 17 QPR1 build and the next Pixel Feature Drop.

consumer-tech.h3: iOS 27 expected on 14 September, but Siri AI skips the EU at launch
consumer-tech.summary: 9to5Mac expects iOS 27 to become available on Monday 14 September, five days after Apple's iPhone event. Macworld reports the update runs on every iPhone from the iPhone 11 onward, though the new Siri AI features will not be available in the EU at launch.
body: The release brings a more context-aware Siri, AI-assisted editing in Photos, faster app launches, improved parental controls and refinements to the Liquid Glass design introduced last year, according to Macworld. Wallet, Messages, Notes, CarPlay and AirPods all pick up new features.

Advanced Apple Intelligence functions require an iPhone 15 Pro or newer. Macworld notes that the Siri AI capabilities will not roll out in the European Union initially, continuing a pattern of delayed EU availability for Apple's AI features amid regulatory uncertainty.

consumer-tech.h3: Windows Insider builds add math support to Narrator and browser resume
consumer-tech.summary: Microsoft released new Windows 11 Insider Preview builds to the Beta and Experimental channels on Tuesday 8 September, adding math reading and navigation to the Narrator screen reader and a smarter phone-to-PC Resume feature.
body: The Windows Insider Blog said Narrator can now read and navigate mathematical content, giving blind and low-vision users clearer and more natural math experiences in documents and web pages.

The Resume feature, which lets users pick up a web page from their phone on the PC, now offers two options when the phone's browser is not installed on the computer: open the page in the PC's default browser or install the phone's browser for a native experience.

consumer-tech.h3: NHTSA audits how Tesla certified the wheel-less Cybercab
consumer-tech.summary: The US safety regulator opened an audit query into Tesla's Cybercab on its Austin launch day, examining how a vehicle with no steering wheel, pedals or mirrors was self-certified as compliant with federal standards, Electrek reported.
body: The Open Audit Query, numbered AQ26002 and prompted by public information, covers an estimated 1,000 Cybercab vehicles. NHTSA said it is examining the process and technical data Tesla relied on and the extent to which the certification depended on determinations that certain Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards do not apply to the vehicle.

US automakers self-certify compliance rather than seeking pre-approval, and many standards were written around a human driver. Tesla told the agency the Cybercab meets all applicable standards and that it plans to expand deployment gradually to more vehicles and locations.

consumer-tech.h3: BYD targets 2 million overseas sales in 2026 after record August exports
consumer-tech.summary: BYD told investors it expects overseas sales of 1.9 to 2 million vehicles this year and more than 2.5 million in 2027, ChinaEVHome reported on Tuesday 8 September, after overseas deliveries hit a record 188,746 units in August.
body: Overseas passenger car and pickup sales reached 1,157,954 units from January to August, up more than 85 percent year on year. Management said growth is currently constrained by shipping capacity and that adding vessels could unlock further exports. Overseas profit averaged around 20,000 yuan per vehicle in the first half.

Local production is expanding. The Indonesia plant has started output, Brazil is ramping towards 300,000 units a year and the Hungary factory is expected to begin assembly in November or December. BYD plans about 6,000 megawatt charging stations abroad through Shell's network and has already entered Germany and the UK, while a battery shortage has left a backlog of roughly 250,000 orders for flash-charging models until early 2027.

consumer-tech.h3: Rivian says R2 pre-order conversion is beating expectations
consumer-tech.summary: At the Goldman Sachs Communacopia and Technology conference on Tuesday 8 September, Rivian said early R2 feedback has been phenomenal and pre-order conversion is running ahead of internal targets, with eyes-off autonomy targeted for 2027.
body: According to a transcript summary published by Investing.com, Rivian used the conference to update investors on the R2 launch, its autonomy roadmap and custom silicon strategy while acknowledging the costs and execution risks of scaling production.

The company said its Gen 3 hardware remains on track for late 2026 and will support multiple performance tiers, with lower-end versions priced below Gen 2 hardware and higher-end versions at about the same level or slightly above. A supervised point-to-point driving feature is due by year end.

consumer-tech.h3: Tesla lines up Semi factory opening and European truck debut this month
consumer-tech.summary: Tesla will formally inaugurate its Semi factory in Sparks, Nevada on 24 September, Electrek reported, days after revealing the European specification of the electric truck at IAA Transportation in Hannover from 15 to 20 September.
body: The invite-only inauguration includes factory tours and ride-alongs and comes five months after the first truck rolled off the line in April. The facility sits next to Gigafactory Nevada and is heavily vertically integrated, with most manufacturing on the same site.

Tesla is building two versions, a Standard Range rated at 325 miles and a Long Range rated at 500 miles, both with an 800 kW three-motor powertrain producing more than 1,000 horsepower. Electrek reported in August that Swedish freight company Einride has ordered 500 Semis, the largest electric truck order to date.
